$comment: Read by scripts/example-coverage.mjs (npm run coverage:examples). The feature inventory comes from the library source; this file adds provider SDK calls/endpoints it can't see (surface), features that must always have an example (required), and features deliberately without one (exempt, with the reason).

exempt.export:effectiveSeed: Resolves MOCK_LLM_SEED against the seed option; examples read the result as mock.seed
exempt.export:envFor: Pure helper behind mock.env(), which examples use
exempt.export:urlsFor: Pure helper behind mock.urls, which examples use
exempt.export:RemoteMockLLM: Used through mock-llm/playwright's llm fixture (a RemoteMockLLM subclass) in playwright-chat-ui
exempt.export:CHAOS_BEHAVIOURS: The list of chaos behaviour names, for tooling; examples name behaviours directly in chaos.weights
exempt.export:RuleBuilder: The type returned by when() and default(); every method is tracked under rule:*
exempt.export:Journal: Reached as mock.journal (used throughout); users don't construct it
exempt.export:approxTokens: The mock's token estimator; examples check token counts through matchers and the providers' countTokens
exempt.export:DEFAULT_PRICING: Applied automatically; rag-knowledge-base overrides it with the pricing option
exempt.export:assertions: All matchers as one object, for registering them elsewhere; each matcher is tracked on its own
exempt.export:matchValue: The partial matcher behind the request matchers
exempt.export:expectationReport: Formats the failure message of assertExpectations(), which examples use
exempt.export:unmatchedReport: Formats the failure message of assertNoUnmatched(), which examples use
exempt.entry:vitest.llmMatchers: For registering the matchers without useMockLLM(); useMockLLM() registers them
exempt.entry:jest.llmMatchers: For registering the matchers without useMockLLM(); useMockLLM() registers them
exempt.entry:playwright.MOCK_LLM_URL_ENV: The env var startMockLLM() sets for the llm fixture; set for you
exempt.entry:playwright.providerRewrite: The URL mapping behind llm.routeBrowser(), which playwright-chat-ui uses
exempt.entry:playwright.PlaywrightMockLLM: The llm fixture's class, for typing custom fixtures; used through the llm fixture
exempt.edge:piiLike: Handling PII-shaped output is app policy (redaction, logging); no example app has such a policy
exempt.option:host: Network binding; the default (127.0.0.1) is what tests want
exempt.option:recordWire: On by default; bedrock-streaming-summarizer reads entry.wire
exempt.step:fromSchema: YAML form of replyFromSchema, which gemini-structured-extraction uses in code
exempt.step:toolCallFromSchema: YAML form of replyToolCallFromSchema, which claude-tool-agent uses in code
